summary: Complete frontend testing of Xbox 360 Dashboard replica (Vortex-Prime-EMU) iteration 13 - Favorites/Groups System and Header Changes. All 14 features verified successfully. Dashboard header shows static avatar with no 'Sign In' text. FAVORITES card present on dashboard. Complete groups CRUD workflow working: Create Group opens Xbox 360 keyboard for naming, groups appear in list, group detail shows Add Games and Delete Group buttons. Add Games shows full library with 'Added' badges. Remove button (X) appears on game tiles in group. Guide Home tab shows Home, My Groups (with count), Settings, Shutdown followed by 5 recently played games. My Groups in Guide shows Create New Group button and lists all groups. Back navigation works in all sub-views.

issues: Some game cover images fail to load (Wikipedia URLs) - Spider-Man, Bionic Commando, Halo 3, Gears of War 2 covers show broken image placeholders. Red Dead Redemption cover loads correctly.

passed_tests: Dashboard header shows no 'Sign In' text - only static avatar circle
Dashboard has 6 main cards: GAMES, FAVORITES, SYSTEM SETTINGS, ACHIEVEMENTS, MARKETPLACE, THEMES
FAVORITES card (data-testid='card-favorites') navigates to favorites view
Favorites view shows 'Create Group' card with + icon
Clicking 'Create Group' opens Xbox 360 on-screen keyboard overlay
Xbox 360 keyboard allows typing group names via key clicks
Pressing Done on keyboard creates group and closes keyboard
Created group appears in favorites list with game count badge
Clicking group card opens group detail view
Group detail shows 'Add Games' and 'Delete Group' buttons
Add Games view shows all 10 games from library
Clicking game in Add Games adds it to group with 'Added' badge
Games added appear in group detail view
Remove button (X) appears on hover for games in group detail
Clicking remove (X) removes game from group
Delete Group removes the group and returns to favorites list
Guide Home tab shows: Home, My Groups (with count), Settings, Shutdown
Guide My Groups button shows correct count (e.g., '2 groups')
Clicking My Groups in Guide shows 'Create New Group' button and group list
Groups in Guide list show name and game count
Create New Group in Guide opens Xbox 360 keyboard
Guide profile row shows static avatar placeholder - no 'Sign In' text
Back navigation works in Favorites sub-views (detail → list → home)
Back navigation works in Guide My Groups (groups → main home tab)
Groups persist in localStorage across page reloads
Footer hint changes to 'Back' in sub-views of Guide
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Game groups state management uses useState with localStorage persistence
Xbox360Keyboard component properly handles submit callback
GuideOverlay correctly receives gameGroups, onCreateGroup, onOpenKeyboard props
Home tab menu correctly ordered with My Groups after Home
Footer hint dynamically changes based on navigation depth in sub-views
test_credentials: No auth required - all mock data
seed_data_creation: 5 recently played games seeded automatically on first visit with Quick Resume badges on first 3

Xbox 360 keyboard opens as overlay for group naming from both dashboard Favorites and Guide My Groups.
